walkthroughs.body_html:
This topic is part of the Edexcel IGCSE GCSE Biology specification.

Ecology & the Environment appears in the assessment, so it's worth knowing well.

You'll meet Ecology & the Environment in exam questions and need to apply your knowledge.

The Edexcel IGCSE board expects you to understand both the concepts and how to use them.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Ecology & the Environment.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
